_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: Although the overwhelming majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.

classification.quality_note: Although the overwhelming majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.33x; +12% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.59; conservative 2yr +16%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY12-FY12 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.3%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.0-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +5.3%/yr (no FY12-FY12 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +5.3%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY12-FY12: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2013-12-20) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.33x (6.3% downside to Bear $33 / +19.3% upside to Bull $42) | Adj composite 3.18 vs market 3.77: gap -0.59 [OVERVALUED] | +12% above the EPP floor $31 (56x FY13E $0.56) | Conservative 2-yr case: +16.4% total (+8.2%/yr) | At 62.9x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $47 sits above the BULL case; segment EBDA +12.7% and Natural Gas Pipelines +16.5% in Q3 2013, forward revenues +27.3% (no FY13 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2013 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
